notes:
What's new

- Spreadsheets open as real grids: Excel (.xlsx) and OpenDocument (.ods) workbooks show their sheets, with column letters and row numbers.
- Click the sheet tabs to switch sheets; Shift+wheel scrolls across columns.
- Numbers are right-aligned, Excel dates show as dates (2025-01-01 rather than 45658), and the header counts rows and columns.
- Copy takes the whole active sheet as tab-separated text.
changelog: WinPreview 1.3.16 - spreadsheet preview (1C, part 2). XLSX and ODS are parsed from their XML parts (shared strings, inline strings, numbers, booleans, cached formulas, ODS repeated rows/columns) and rendered as a grid with sheet tabs, column letters, row numbers, numeric alignment and number-format date conversion. The office dock now carries Copy / info / open with / settings / fullscreen. 20 new checks cover values, dates, dimensions, tab switching, legacy isolation and a 200x12 workbook.
